'''2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)''' was the Players Committee retro match-play event on GEMP, May–July 2025. [[Timo Dusel]] defeated [[Patrick Johnson]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-04-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-may-to-july-2025/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Andy Talaga]]<ref name="overview">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85488 2025 Retro Gemp Match Play Championship], forum.starwarsccg.org (22 March 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011191133/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85488.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' May–July 2025
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1555 2025 Retro GEMPC Forum]
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85775 forum t=85775]
* '''Video:''' [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQSFYZX0M9YTCrWDXcWybAWlrzF3kph1q YouTube playlist]
* '''Deck changes:''' From the round of 128 through the round of 16, players could change decks between rounds. In the Top 8, players could submit a different list for each round.<ref name="overview"/>

== Final standings ==

Final standings for all 96 players, from the email [[Andy Talaga]] sent to participants on 9 July 2025.
